steps.en: Fill in the form at admission.saim.schoolmate.id.
Check your email for the login link.

steps.id: Bayar biaya pendaftaran, isi data siswa dan orang tua, unggah dokumen, pilih jadwal observasi.
steps.en: Pay the registration fee, fill in student and parent details, upload documents, choose an observation slot.

steps.id: Pengumuman penerimaan, lalu bayar uang pangkal; setelah lunas orang tua mendapat akun LMS SAIM.
steps.en: Results are announced, then pay the entry fee; once paid, parents receive an LMS account.

notes.id: Usia minimal per Juli 2026: PG A 2 tahun, PG B 3 tahun, TK A 4 tahun, SD 6 tahun. Biaya pendaftaran SMP/SMA termasuk tes kesehatan.
notes.en: Minimum age by July 2026: PG A 2, PG B 3, TK A 4, SD 6. SMP/SMA registration includes a health check.
